info.title: DMARC Report Universal API
info.description: DMARC Report lets teams monitor DMARC, forensic, MTA-STS, domain, account, and Postmaster reporting data through the DMARC Report API.

post.description: Creates a domain account in DMARC Report.

domainId.description: Domain identifier linked to the account.
